requestedIntent: Keep reversible contained work fast after ACEF admission rejects it: mechanically bound focused verification, repeated commands, command runtime, broad-suite timing, subagent use, and scope expansion without creating per-task ACEF artifacts.
limitations: The source capability is enforced. A target repository must refresh its ACEF installation, and the client must have the ACEF global dispatcher wired, before raw native commands are intercepted there.

The 10-minute budget measures elapsed verification time from the first wrapped command, not all agent reasoning or read-only inspection time. Scope expansion is bounded indirectly through command/subagent limits and the stop-at-green rule.
Broad closeout is intentionally allowed once on a clean worktree and may run for up to 30 minutes because it is a separate batch-level certification action, not native implementation feedback.
